reply: [{"query": "根据本指南，申办者的重要方案偏离（important protocol deviation）信息是否需要纳入IND年度报告（21 CFR 312.33 annual report）中提交给FDA？", "query_en": "According to this guidance, must sponsors' important protocol deviations be included in the IND annual report (21 CFR 312.33) submitted to FDA?", "topic": "方案偏离与IND年度报告", "absence_terms": ["annual report", "312.33", "IND annual report"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 10, "text": "In addition to including protocol deviation information in their clinical study reports (see section III.B.1), during the conduct of the clinical investigation, sponsors must report serious and unexpected suspected adverse reactions for drug products under 21 CFR 312.32"}, "rationale": "文档详细说明了方案偏离应纳入临床研究报告、DV域及严重不良事件强制报告（312.32等），是申办者自然会追问的报告渠道问题，但全文未提及IND年度报告（312.33）是否需要包含方案偏离信息，属于覆盖空白。"}, {"query": "本指南是否规定了申办者未能按时向FDA报告重要方案偏离时会面临的具体执法后果（如警告信或其他处罚措施）？", "query_en": "Does this guidance specify the concrete enforcement consequences (e.g., warning letters or other penalties) FDA may impose on a sponsor for failing to timely report important protocol deviations?", "topic": "未及时报告方案偏离的执法后果", "absence_terms": ["warning letter", "enforcement action", "penalty", "sanction"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 12, "text": "Sponsors should consider closing a trial site when despite attempts at remediation, the site is unable to maintain GCP standards, comply with the protocol, or implement measures to identify and/or address recurring important protocol deviations."}, "rationale": "文档讨论了申办者监测、评估、必要时关闭试验机构等管理措施，是行业用户自然关心的后续问题，但全文未说明FDA对申办者未及时报告重要方案偏离本身会采取何种执法或处罚手段，属于未覆盖事项。"}]
